name: OGBG-MolTox21: Tox21 Molecular Graph Property Prediction Benchmark
description: OGBG-MolTox21 is a molecular graph property prediction benchmark derived from the NIH Tox21 Data Challenge and MoleculeNet, containing 7,831 small molecules with an average of 18.6 atoms and 19.3 chemical bonds per molecule. Molecules are represented as 2D graphs with rich atom and bond features. The dataset comprises 12 binary classification targets measuring toxicity against nuclear receptor signaling pathways and cellular stress response pathways. Evaluated under a scaffold split (Train: 6,264, Validation: 783, Test: 784 molecules) using average ROC-AUC across all 12 tasks.
